title: 8th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/3/2025).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 1/3/2025 to 4/3/2025).

Question by Thoddoo MP Hussain Sameer to Minister of Dhivehi Language, Culture and Heritage Adam Naseer Ibrahim: the minister said on 16 April 2025 that 12 lorry-loads of waste were removed from the National Museum when interior improvement work began; were records, photos or videos taken of those items, and did he verify that none of the museum's artefacts were destroyed?

Question by Thoddoo MP Hussain Sameer to the same minister: how was it decided that the removed items were unwanted, was that decision made by technical experts, and what kinds of items were included?
First reading of the bill amending Law No. 24/2014 (Special Economic Zones Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau.

First reading of a resolution by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim noting that foreigners married to Maldivians and living in the Maldives do not receive Aasandha health insurance, to ascertain members' views on the matter.
Preliminary debate on Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's bill amending Law No. 8/2009 (Maldives Pension Act).
Preliminary debate on a resolution by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim noting how difficult it is to obtain blood in the Maldives, to ascertain members' views on solving the problem.
Continued debate on the Human Organ Transplantation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Feydhoo South MP Ibrahim Didi.

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's submission for Parliament to appoint 3 members to the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Commission under Article 17(a)(1) of Law No. 16/2025 (Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took questions on waste cleared from the National Museum, introduced an SEZ Act amendment and an Aasandha resolution, debated pension and blood-supply proposals and the organ transplant bill, and received a committee report on Media Commission appointments.
